newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Asahimas says 1996 net drops to 44.1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Asahimas says 1996 net drops to 44.1 bln.

text.p: Indonesian glass maker PT Asahimas Flat Glass Co Ltd said on Monday it posted a net profit of 44.1 billion rupiah in 1996 against 73.71 billion in 1995.
The company said in a statement it posted an earnings per share of 102 rupiah in 1996, against 208 rupiah in 1995.
The company said it had had net sales of 347.3 billion rupiah in 1996, which was 14 percent below 1995 net sales of 403.6 billion rupiah.
Asahimas also said the company raised its domestic price for commodity glass and some specialty glasses by 20 and 10 percent respectively starting March 1, 1997.

"This is a second price increase in 1997 (the first was effective January 1) in response to an improvement in the demand for glass in the domestic markets as well as a move to close the gap between international and domestic prices," the statement said.
